column1: # cheri-rvy sources -- the authoritative pin record for the aivhai-cheri-rvy image.  Issue #95.
# cheribuild follows branch tips.  Pinning cheribuild therefore pins the BUILD
# LOGIC and not the toolchain, so every source it builds is pinned here, by
# commit, and the Dockerfile fetches exactly that commit and hands it to
# The same commits are pinned as submodules in AIVHAI-Everything (AIVHAI-Sigil#58).
# A disagreement between the two records is a defect, not a detail.
# Branches are those cheribuild main names for its rvy-* targets as of
# 9224aad4 (2026-09-30).  Each is a strict descendant of the reference Robert
# Watson gave on AIVHAI-Sigil#95 (2026-09-29): LLVM +1 commit, QEMU +20.
